//: Typechecks the webview smoke harness ONLY — the `*.smoke.test.ts` files, their `*-fixture.ts` setup, and the harness itself. That is the one part of this extension that touches DOM globals, so it is the one part that gets `lib: DOM`. The main tsconfig deliberately excludes the same set: extension-host code has no DOM at runtime, and letting it compile against DOM types would turn a runtime crash into a silent type-check pass.
